#### Functions (2)

- L13-16 _function_ `float BlueNoiseScalar(uint2 ScreenCoord, uint FrameIndex)` — Spatiotemporal Blue Noise lookup texture with scalar output. Returns a uniformly distributed random variable in [0, 1] that is blue (no low frequencies) in both xy (screen space) and in z (frame index), which is designed to work with temporal accumulation. The texture is 128x128x64 and tiled, based on "Spatiotemporal Blue Noise Masks" [Wolfe et al 2022] and https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/rendering-in-real-time-with-spatiotemporal-blue-noise-textures-part-1/
- L23-26 _function_ `float2 BlueNoiseVec2(uint2 ScreenCoord, uint FrameIndex)` — Spatiotemporal Blue Noise lookup texture with float2 output. Returns a uniformly distributed random vector in [0, 1] that is blue (no low frequencies) in both xy (screen space) and in z (frame index), which is designed to work with temporal accumulation. The texture is 128x128x64 and tiled.

- L32-49 _function_ `uint3 GetGroupCountWrapped(const uint TargetGroupCount, uint2 DimensionLimit)` — Wrapping number of groups to Y and Z dimension if X group count overflows DimensionLimit. Calculate the linear group index as: uint LinearGroupId = GroupId.X + (GroupId.Z * WRAPPED_GROUP_STRIDE + GroupId.Y) * WRAPPED_GROUP_STRIDE; Note that you must use an early out because LinearGroupId may be larger than the ideal due to wrapping.

- L214-226 _function_ `FFloatType DFFastLocalSubtractDemote(FDFType Lhs, FDFType Rhs)` — Subtract using only 2 ops instead of ~20, and convert the result to fp32 (1 op) CAREFUL, this has strict input preconditions to get output that has any precision at all. Assuming you require a precision of 2^-4, the precondition for Lhs and Rhs is (abs(Lhs) < 2^20 && abs(Rhs) < 2^20) \|\| ( abs(Lhs) < 2^43 && abs(Rhs) < 2^43 && Sign(Lhs) == Sign(Rhs) && abs(trunc(log2(abs(Lhs))) - trunc(log2(abs(Rhs)))) < 1 ) As the preconditions imply, this does not work for addition due to FP rounding.

Returns true otherwise, only works for 'acute angled' cones, where the angle is < 90 degrees.
